verdict_reason: Expensive on both markers — present PE sits above smoothed 10yr earnings and above what this stock has typically traded at over its own history.
devils_advocate: This isn't price euphoria — price has actually fallen (Rs 405.92 → Rs 362.9 over the last FY), it's earnings compression driving the ratio. FY082-083 EPS (15.71) is near the low end of a multi-year decline from the 072-073 peak (43.10), so the high PE reflects a shrunk denominator, not the market bidding the stock up. That cuts both ways: if EPS keeps falling this is a value trap dressed up as a normal PE band, but if the decline is cyclical (rate spread compression, provisioning cycle) and EPS recovers, today's price could reprice as cheap in hindsight. The SELL-CASE lean is on trailing numbers only — worth checking whether the EPS slide has bottomed before acting on it.
